Baseline maintenance: this story removes censused mechanism(s) `env_var::REBAR_HLC_NOW` (`.github/mechanism-baseline.json:505`) and `env_var::REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER` (`:608`). Because `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change and commit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` (operator-sanctioned on the epic; precedent commit 81da792). State the sanction in the commit message.

Companion fact: the story also ADDS a censused mechanism, `test_helper::tests/_child_hooks.py` (glob-shaped `tests/_*.py` detection in `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_ci.py::detect_test_helpers`). `--update-stale` refuses to write while `new>0`, so the `# mechanism-ok: test_helper tests/_child_hooks.py — <reason>` marker in that file's first lines (see Approach) must be in place BEFORE running `--update-stale`; otherwise the stale rows are not drained and `test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree` stays red.

## Context / Problem
Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

`src/rebar/_store/hlc.py:57-67` reads `REBAR_HLC_NOW` (setters: `tests/unit/test_hlc.py:33-77`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_js_safe_integers.py:91`, `tests/interfaces/io/test_export_ndjson_js_safe.py:96` — all in-process; `tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py:599,1693-1811` — subprocess). It controls the physical component of the HLC tick (`hlc.py:125,130`) and compaction horizons (`compact.py:253`, `compact_trigger.py:113`, `compact_txn.py:469`). `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py:179-195` reads `REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER` (setter: `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_process_death.py:101`, subprocess + SIGKILL); it pauses after the first `*.retired` rename (`:285`). Both carry `# read-via:` markers budgeted in `tests/scripts/test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py:49-53` and `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py:61-65`, and appear in `docs/env-vars.md:57,160` and `.github/mechanism-baseline.json:505,608` (`env_var::REBAR_HLC_NOW`, `env_var::REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER`).

## Approach
Mirror the store's injectable-callable idiom: `src/rebar/_commands/completion_verifier_run.py:76` (`clock: Callable[[], int] = monotonic_ns`), `src/rebar/_store/push_classify.py:88,100` (`sleep_fn`), `src/rebar/_store/reclaim_eligibility.py:19,45,57` (`now=`).
- `hlc.py`: `_clock: Callable[[], int] = time.time_ns`; `physical_now()` returns `_clock()`; delete `:61-66` and the docstring sentence `:36-37`.
- `compact_txn.py`: `def _no_rename_barrier(n_renamed: int) -> None: return None`; `_rename_barrier: Callable[[int], None] = _no_rename_barrier`; `:285` becomes `_rename_barrier(len(renamed))`; delete `:179-195` and `import time` (`:29`, its only user).
- In-process tests monkeypatch `hlc._clock` (`test_hlc.py`, the two js_safe fixtures).
- Subprocess tests: new `tests/_child_hooks.py::child_env(env, *, hlc_now=None, rename_barrier=None)` prepends `tests/_child_hooks_shim/` to `PYTHONPATH` and sets `REBAR_TEST_HLC_NOW` / `REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER`; new `tests/_child_hooks_shim/sitecustomize.py` (runs at child interpreter start; `python -m rebar.cli` and the `rebar` console script both process it) rebinds `rebar._store.hlc._clock` and `rebar._commands.compact_txn._rename_barrier` (the reached/release file protocol moves here verbatim). The env reads now live in test code only; `gen_env_registry` scans `src/rebar` (`scripts/gen_env_registry.py:449`) so both rows leave `docs/env-vars.md`. Rewire `test_concurrency_regression.py:596-602,1637-1646` through `child_env` and rename the ten `REBAR_HLC_NOW` keys to `REBAR_TEST_HLC_NOW`; `test_compact_process_death.py:100-102` uses `child_env(subprocess_env(), rename_barrier=barrier)`.
- `tests/_child_hooks.py` is a new `tests/_*.py` module, which `scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_ci.py::detect_test_helpers` censuses as `test_helper::tests/_child_hooks.py` (filename-glob shape: the marker lives in the file's first lines). Open the file with `# mechanism-ok: test_helper tests/_child_hooks.py — replaces the production env reads REBAR_HLC_NOW / REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER (this ticket)` so `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0`. `tests/_child_hooks_shim/sitecustomize.py` sits in a subdirectory and is not censused.
- `test_hlc.py:32-34` monkeypatches `_clock`; `:89-94` asserts `re.search(r"os\.environ", source) is None`.
- Budgets: `tests/scripts/test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py:49-53` drop the hlc row, `_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP = 3`; `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py:61-65` drop the compact_txn row, `_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP = 1`.
- Regenerate `docs/env-vars.md`; run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` (drops the two stale `env_var` rows; precedent commit `81da792`) and commit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` in the same change (operator sanction recorded on the epic).

## Scope
`src/rebar/_store/hlc.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py`, new `tests/_child_hooks.py` and `tests/_child_hooks_shim/sitecustomize.py`, `tests/unit/test_hlc.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_js_safe_integers.py`, `tests/interfaces/io/test_export_ndjson_js_safe.py`, `tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_process_death.py`, `tests/scripts/test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py`, `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py`, `docs/env-vars.md`, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`. Out of scope: `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` (reconciler epic), every other env read in `src/rebar`, and the HLC tick/compaction-horizon logic itself (`hlc.py:125,130`, `compact.py:253`, `compact_trigger.py:113`, `compact_txn.py:469` keep calling `physical_now()` unchanged).

## Testing
- `pytest tests/unit/test_hlc.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli_js_safe_integers.py tests/interfaces/io/test_export_ndjson_js_safe.py -q`.
- `pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_process_death.py -q` (child reaches the barrier via the shim; SIGKILL recovery unchanged).
- `pytest tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py -k hlc -q`, `pytest tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py -k skew -q`, `pytest tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py -k scenario -q`.
- Edge: `REBAR_HLC_NOW=1 rebar create task t` in a scratch repo → the ticket timestamp is wall-clock (the variable is ignored); `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check`; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0`; `python scripts/check_orphaned_load.py` clean after the SIGKILL test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC1 `git grep -n 'REBAR_HLC_NOW\|REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER' -- src` empty; `docs/env-vars.md` has neither row (verified by the grep and `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check`).
- [ ] AC2 The seam tests `tests/scripts/test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py` and `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py` are green with `read-via` marker counts as budgeted (verified by `pytest`).
- [ ] AC3 `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree` green and `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0`; `make verify` green.
